name: Hayami Suzuka
source:
A female teacher in the school who works as a head of year.
Though still young, she is the strictest teacher in the school.
Students dislike her for being too serious and inflexible about school rules, but for the same reason parents and other teachers trust her.
Two years ago she got married with her university friend. Strict at work, she looks with warm smile towards her beloved husband at home.
